entities.name: Elizah
entities.description: Ethan's subconscious guardian who manifested during childhood emergencies, trauma, or when Ethan was cornered.
entities.quote: Elizah isn’t a “new form” in Season 2. He is a subconscious guardian who appeared: in childhood emergencies in early fights when Ethan was traumatized when Ethan was cornered when he blacked out

entities.name: Yoshiko
entities.description: Arashi's daughter, Nyxia's childhood friend and secret protector, trained as a spy by Corvani.
entities.quote: She was always watching Nyxia in shadows She returns as: her lawyer her manager secretly her protector She has Nullborn connection through Arashi

entities.name: Eldrich
entities.description: A character cursed by Khalid to guard the throne for decades, unable to die or leave.
entities.quote: He was cursed by Khalid Couldn’t die Couldn’t leave the throne Guarded it silently for decades Watching the world move on Still loyal to Liam → John → Zaan’s honor

entities.name: RAB
entities.description: An elite unit in Bangladesh where Ethan's father served.
entities.quote: Ethan’s father is RAB (elite unit) Already met Agnus in the past Agnus was junior to him So Ethan's father outranked Zayn’s father

entities.name: Nullborn
entities.description: An organization that sought to imprison or kill balanced-power hosts.
entities.quote: Nullborn wanted to imprison or kill balanced-power hosts. Arashi refused. So: He lost leadership He lost his reputation He lost his daughter He became hunted

updates.new_facts: He left Nullborn because he refused to harm balanced-power hosts, losing his leadership and daughter.
updates.quote: Arashi leaving Nullborn because of Nyxia This is a peak twist. Nullborn wanted to imprison or kill balanced-power hosts. Arashi refused.

updates.new_facts: Knew Yoshiko's truth from Season 1, keeping the secret to protect Nyxia.
updates.quote: Zayn knew Yoshiko’s truth from Season 1 — CONFIRMED This is peak Zayn. You said: Yoshiko wanted to be Nyxia’s manager Zayn voted “yes” immediately Because he knew something

timeline_events.title: Corvani's Last Mission
timeline_events.description: Corvani assigned Yoshiko to protect Nyxia and monitor various organizations before vanishing.
timeline_events.quote: Corvani’s last act before the pocket dimension: “Watch Stitch. Watch DEW. Watch ECAP. Protect the girl.” And Yoshiko followed that mission for years
